# acme-platform

> A Stackra app: a web console and one service with its notes module, on the @stackra/* catalog.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): front page, quick start and the commands
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): agent rules and the programming model v3.1
- [docs/template-guide.md](docs/template-guide.md): the tree, file ownership, member kinds and what to replace
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): how changes land
- [Stackra docs](https://docs.stackra.figentra.com): the framework

## Entry points

- [package.json](package.json): root scripts (dev, gen, verify, validate, new)
- [pnpm-workspace.yaml](pnpm-workspace.yaml): members and catalogs
- [runway.yaml](runway.yaml): product key, environments and targets
- [services/example/README.md](services/example/README.md): the example service and its notes module
- [apps/console/README.md](apps/console/README.md): the web console
- [.mcp.yaml](.mcp.yaml): the MCP servers for coding agents
- [.github/workflows/ci.yml](.github/workflows/ci.yml): the Quality Gate
